mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies at Fireman's Park and a waxing gibbous moon, though there are no space station sightings tonight.

The City of Verona is running an I Voted sticker contest for K-12 students. Designs must include the text I Voted, be original artwork, and be submitted by July 22 at 4:00 PM. Community voting will take place from July 28 through August 7 to select winners from four age categories.
We have a busy couple of days ahead with live music today at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company, followed by the Dane County Farmers Market tomorrow at the Capitol Square.
In our weekly police report, on July 13, officers responded to a call where a driver had become stuck on a large rock, resulting in an arrest for O-W-I.

Today's flavor is the decadent Chocolate Volcano. Please note that the restaurant is currently closed, but they will reopen at 10:00 AM today for you to enjoy your treat. Tomorrow, look forward to the Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough flavor.
